Now, these special violins (which are like big, fancy string instruments) were made by a man named Stradivari, who was a super violin maker. He made them over 300 years ago, and nobody has been able to make violins that sound as beautiful and magical as his since then.

So, people think Stradivari’s violins are very, very valuable because:
- They sound super amazing.
- There aren’t many left, because they are really old.
- Everyone wants to play or listen to them because they are so special.

It’s kind of like if you had a toy that was the only one in the whole world and it did really cool things that no other toy could do! That’s why Stradivari violins are so special and worth a lot of money.
